mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing temperatures around 67 degrees, though it feels like 65, under overcast skies near the Verona Area High School. We are currently in a Waxing Crescent moon phase.
For city news, we have no new emails or major alerts to share today, so it is a good time to catch up on some of our local highlights.

There is plenty to do in town. Today, you can check out Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the lineup includes the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, and yoga at Insight Wellness.
In our weekly police report, officers noted an incident on September 5 involving a social media prank where slices of cheese were placed on windshields, causing no damage to vehicles.
Regarding our local Culver's, please note that the store is closed for a remodel. They will open today at 10:00 AM, and we look forward to their return to serving the community.
